diagnosticReview.interpretation: 182 objects use official minimal source representations; one body identity differs from its API metadata. No source was rewritten to resolve either category.
diagnosticReview.metadataOnlyBehavior: Recognize API-bound original bytes; default to original-content display. Explicit raw editing remains available under existing file permissions and candidate identity checks. Do not invent missing SQL or page structure.
diagnosticReview.identityConflictBehavior: Keep a distinct diagnostic and readonly view. Platform-side correction is outside this change.

issues.cause: Standalone Python lacked a usable HTTPS CA trust bundle for the official login service.
issues.change: Bundle pinned certifi CA resources, preserve system trust and TLS verification, distinguish login-service certificate errors.
issues.verification: Packaged backend live login, same-process session and authenticated system-list query passed using an existing authorized credential.

issues.cause: Editor URI authority normalization lowercased mixed-case workspace IDs.
issues.change: Preserve exact workspace identity in URI query fields across virtual documents, changes, readonly views and QuickDiff.
issues.verification: Actual CodeBuddy Extension Host with a mixed-case synthetic project opened and saved native PAGE script, SQL view, raw view and PAGE manager.

issues.cause: Opening a source repeatedly requested the full workspace status scan.
issues.change: Reuse registered checkout metadata and keep status scanning off the source request queue.

issues.cause: Source tree exposed physical paths without using system, datasource and menu metadata.
issues.change: Use project-scoped cached labels and menu hierarchy; retain physical paths.

issues.cause: Login display waited for repeated full-project status scans that reloaded baseline bodies and scope settings.
issues.change: Read registered baseline hashes without baseline bodies, resolve scope once per scan and coalesce concurrent same-project status requests.
issues.verification: State and hash transitions plus concurrent refresh tests; installed full-project timing recorded separately.
